∀ (n : Nat) (a : Etingof.SymGroupAlgebra n),
  Eq.{1} (Ideal.map.{0, 0, 0} (Etingof.signTwist n) (Ideal.span.{0} (Singleton.singleton.{0, 0} a)))
    (Ideal.span.{0} (Singleton.singleton.{0, 0} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (Etingof.signTwist n) a)))

∀ (n : Nat) (g : Equiv.Perm.{1} (Fin n)),
  Eq.{1}
    (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (Etingof.signTwist n)
      (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (MonoidAlgebra.of.{0, 0} Complex (Equiv.Perm.{1} (Fin n))) g))
    (HSMul.hSMul.{0, 0, 0} (Int.cast.{0} (Units.val.{0} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} Equiv.Perm.sign.{0} g)))
      (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (MonoidAlgebra.of.{0, 0} Complex (Equiv.Perm.{1} (Fin n))) g))

∀ (n : Nat) {V : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommGroup.{u_1} V] [inst_1 : Module.{0, u_1} Complex V]
  [inst_2 : Module.{0, u_1} (Etingof.SymGroupAlgebra n) V]
  [IsScalarTower.{0, 0, u_1} Complex (Etingof.SymGroupAlgebra n) V] (g : Equiv.Perm.{1} (Fin n)) (v : V),
  Eq.{u_1 + 1}
    (HSMul.hSMul.{0, u_1, u_1}
      (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (Etingof.signTwist n)
        (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (MonoidAlgebra.of.{0, 0} Complex (Equiv.Perm.{1} (Fin n))) g))
      v)
    (HSMul.hSMul.{0, u_1, u_1} (Int.cast.{0} (Units.val.{0} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} Equiv.Perm.sign.{0} g)))
      (HSMul.hSMul.{0, u_1, u_1} (DFunLike.coe.{1, 1, 1} (MonoidAlgebra.of.{0, 0} Complex (Equiv.Perm.{1} (Fin n))) g)
        v))
